description: Interior dimensions, volume, floor area and maximum payload for 47 shipping containers, truck trailers, rail wagons and air ULDs. Use this when someone asks for the internal or interior dimensions, cubic capacity, floor area, payload or weight limit of a container or trailer — 20ft, 40ft, 40ft High Cube, 45ft, reefer, open top, flat rack, 53ft dry van, curtainsider, boxcar, LD-3, PMC and more. Called with no arguments (optionally filtered by mode) it lists the whole catalog with the slug for each vessel.

mode.description: When listing, restrict to one transport mode. Ignored when `vessel` is given.

vessel.description: The vessel to look up, as a slug ("20ft-container") or plain name ("20 foot container", "40HC"). Omit to list the catalog instead.

name: get_container_dimensions

vessel.description: Present when a single vessel was requested.

title: Container & Vehicle Dimensions
